title: Enterprise Connectivity: net transfer invoice handling
content:
## Situation and capability
Enterprise Connectivity: When the corresponding accounting action is due, this entry governs net transfer invoice. The accountant issues a network net-service invoice for the selected source export and accepted assessment. One positive net receivable entry becomes visible immediately, and the invoice receipt confirms issuance.

## Handling condition
Before issuing the net invoice, complete its accepted-source pricing assessment.

## Invocation
invoice_network_9ee25cfe is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call) by the agent.

## Parameter customer_id
Net transfer invoice uses `customer_id`: Id class — Customer profile identifier copied from find_customers.

## Parameter network_holding_id
Net transfer invoice uses `network_holding_id`: Id class — Network contract identifier copied from find_network_holdings.

## Parameter network_event_id
Net transfer invoice uses `network_event_id`: Id class — Authoritative source evidence event identifier copied from find_network_events.

## Parameter source_event_id
Net transfer invoice uses `source_event_id`: Id class — Exact export or net invoice identifier copied from find_network_events or the preceding invoice receipt.

## Parameter related_event_id
Net transfer invoice uses `related_event_id`: Id class — Pricing review identifier copied from find_network_events.

## Parameter request_id
Net transfer invoice uses `request_id`: Id class — Customer acceptance identifier copied from the actual preceding authorization receipt.

## Parameter meter_code
Net transfer invoice uses `meter_code`: Enum class — Allowed values: primary (the source uses the generic primary meter); internet_egress (traffic leaves the public internet interface); port_hours (a provisioned line port accrues hours); cross_zone (traffic crosses availability zones); cross_region (traffic crosses cloud regions); private_egress (traffic uses private interconnect); ingress (traffic enters the network); nat_gb (NAT processing is measured by GB); nat_hours (NAT provisioning is measured by hours); public_ipv4 (allocated IPv4 address-hours are measured); connection_setup (a new physical connection is completed); loadbalancer (load balancer capacity-unit-hours are measured); none (no measured source or pricing branch applies)

## Parameter source_subtype
Net transfer invoice uses `source_subtype`: Enum class — Allowed values: primary (the source uses the generic primary meter); supplemental (ancillary service is billed); setup (an activation setup fee is billed); termination (a resource exit liability is billed); resumption (a restoration fee is billed); return_fee (a failed remittance fee is billed); marketplace (a marketplace product charge is recorded); service_credit (an outage concession is recorded); correction (an erroneous invoice is adjusted); remittance (a payment receipt is allocated); refund (cash is returned to its source payment); incident (an operational outage is recorded); request (a customer authorization is filed); review (an accountant assessment is recorded); amendment (signed contract attributes are amended)

## Parameter pricing_component
Net transfer invoice uses `pricing_component`: Enum class — Allowed values: none (no measured source or pricing branch applies); negotiated (an approved negotiated rate applies); reservation (a signed commitment covers the quantity); promotion (an eligible campaign is selected); portfolio (the supported portfolio price is selected); standard (no preferential price applies); spot (spot capacity pricing applies)

## Parameter period
Net transfer invoice uses `period`: Fixed-format class — UTC billing month in YYYY-MM format; no empty value.

## Parameter amount
Net transfer invoice uses `amount`: Fixed-format class — Positive receivable component in unit USD to two decimals, decimal number with two-decimal precision, supplied after final half-up rounding and stored at two decimals.

## Successful receipt
A dictionary with event_id (string business-event identifier) and amount (USD decimal number to two decimals); this receipt confirms completion.
